# eas_account_variable (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Account-level environment variable. It belongs to the account configured on
# the provider (account_name), so no app/account id is needed.
resource "eas_account_variable" "this" {
  name         = "API_KEY"
  value        = "my-api-key"
  visibility   = "SECRET"
  environments = ["production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environments` (Set of String) The environments of the account environment variable
- `name` (String) The name of the account environment variable
- `value` (String) The value of the account environment variable
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the account environment variable

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the environment variable
